caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mirror with a dark brown wooden frame, featuring a prominent top section with an arched shape. This arched area includes an intricate, symmetrical decoration of scrolling, leafy patterns in dark brown, giving the appearance of carved or cut woodwork. The interior of the mirror is rendered in shades of pale gray and off-white, with subtle, shadowy gradients suggesting reflective glass. The overall composition centers the mirror on a plain, light-beige background. In the lower right corner of the background, part of the artist’s name, “Rex Do...,” is handwritten in small, neat letters. There are no other objects or embellishments present in the drawing.
title: Looking-glass
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
